senses.gloss: m. (קרטב, Parel of קטב; cmp. קַרְטוּפְנָא a. קָטָף) ḳarṭub, ḳurṭub, a small liquid measure equal to 1/64 of a Log.
units: Tosef. B. Bath. V, 10; B. Bath. 90ᵃ (Rashb. a. l. quot. of Tosef. l. c. וחצי שמינית וכ׳ one sixteenth of a Log).
<cite ref="Mishnah Menachot 12:4">Men. XII, 4</cite> (<cite ref="Menachot 103b:16">103ᵇ</cite>) <he>קר׳</he> (Ms. M. <he>קור׳</he>); Tosef. ib. XII, 9 <he>קור׳</he>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Mikvaot 7:5">Ib. VII, 5</cite>; <cite ref="Chullin 26a">Ḥull. 26ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Makkot 4a">Macc. 4ᵃ</cite>; a. e.
